What is the ratio of the total number of computers sold from store S on Tuesday, Monday and Sunday taken together to that sold from store P on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday taken together?
solution:
Calculation:

Now, the ratio of the total number of computers sold from store S on Tuesday, Monday and Sunday taken together to that sold from store P on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday taken together

⇒ (68 + 74 + 78) : (49 + 70 + 90)

⇒ 220 : 209

⇒ 20 : 19

**∴ The ratio of the total number of computers sold from store S on Tuesday, Monday and Sunday taken together to that sold from store P on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday taken together is 20 : 19.**
